description: Board of Investment of Sri Lanka - Order to amend the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka  (fees & Charges) Rules published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1787/13 dated 22.12.2011
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to rules (specifically fees and charges) made by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka under Section 18 of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka Law, No. 4 of 1978. The content involves regulatory changes to financial charges, water supply rates, land premiums, and annual fees for enterprises, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation.
